offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 5 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 18 exited the pit stop in the working lane slightly behind Car 20 in the fast lane. Appendix L Chapter IV Article 5 b) states that Car 18 should blend into the fast lane as soon as it is safe to do so and without impeding any car in the fast lane. Because Car 20 was in the fast lane and was followed closely by Car 77, it is not possible to determine that Car 18 could have blended prior to the Pit Exit. At the Pit Exit line, Car 18 was still behind Car 20. Car 18 overtook Car 20 in the Pit Exit Road. This is not prohibited.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 18 Pit Lane Incident
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
